_note: READ-ONLY public Telegram call watcher. Polls PUBLIC https://t.me/s/<channel> previews only: no account, no login. Never sends, joins, reacts, clicks bot links or pays. Channel text is untrusted data; only regex-extracted contract addresses and $tickers are used. Copy this file to config.json and replace the example channels with PUBLIC channels you choose to follow.
_source_groups_note: channel -> group id. Channels sharing a group count as ONE source for the 2+ channel HIGH rule. Leave EMPTY (default): every channel counts separately. Group only if data proves two channels post identical calls (mirrors), never from names alone.
private_gap: List private groups you cannot watch here (names only, never content). They are reported as not covered.
